title: Emperor Palpatine
subtitle: Sith
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: After the Sith Lord Darth Sidious declared himself the Emperor of the new Galactic Empire, it spelled certain doom for freedom in the galaxy. After destroying the Jedi Order, nothing could stand in his way until a scrappy band of rebels and the secret son of his apprentice, Darth Vader, was able to oppose him. Cruel and evil, he cared little for the problems of real people in the galaxy.
